title: Skillet Mushroom Breakfast Delight
description: A hearty skillet breakfast filled with sautéed mushrooms, ovoli, and Slovakian flair, cooked to perfection in a quaint skillet.
instructions: 1. Crack the ovoli into the quaint skillet.
2. Add the malty and Slovakian to the skillet and stir
3. Add the mushroom and cook until browned.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
5. Cook the ovoli until the whites are set.
6. Flip the ovoli and cook until the yolks are cooked to your preference.
7. Serve the mushroom and ovoli together in the skillet.
8. Garnish with any additional Slovakian flair.
